reuse.why: Extends the shared assertBankAccountNotLinked guard so every provider gets the flag, but re-writes the unlink field reset instead of sharing it with unlinkAccount.

duplication.why: The eight-field db.updateAccount reset is a verbatim copy of the one in unlinkAccount, so the meaning of 'unlinked' now lives in two places.

placement.why: The rule is in the shared link guard, but a function named assert... now performs the takeover write, mixing validation with mutation.

scope.why: Touches only the guard, the six link handlers' parameter threading and a release note.

maintainability.why: Single guard keeps providers consistent, but the misleadingly named side-effecting assert, an extra replace-only not-found branch and the copied reset would bother a maintainer.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in accounts/app.ts re-implements unlinkAccount's local reset instead of calling a shared unlink helper.

disguised_duplication.where: The unlink reset is copied verbatim, not disguised.
